pub fn hash2(x: i64, y: i64, seed: u64) -> f32 {
    let mut h = (x as u64).wrapping_mul(0x8DA6_B343)

# Make a small JPEG preview for viewing (keeps image payloads ~100–250 KB).

out=$2
dir=${TMPDIR:-[local path redacted]

rm -f "$tmp" "$tmp.png"
ls -la "$out" | awk '{print $5, $9}'
